# A section 13 backend pass applies to Go packages and to loGo/s
# packages, under logos and under plain go. The fourth combination
# (a loGo/s package under plain go) cannot occur: plain go never
# compiles .lgo files.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOARCH=arm64

cd m
logos build -o logos_go.exe ./goonly
go build -o plain_go.exe ./goonly
logos build -o logos_lgo.exe ./lgoonly
! go build -o plain_lgo.exe ./lgoonly
! exists plain_lgo.exe
go tool objdump -s 'main\.loadPair' logos_go.exe
stdout 'LDP'
go tool objdump -s 'main\.loadPair' plain_go.exe
stdout 'LDP'
go tool objdump -s 'main\.loadPair' logos_lgo.exe
stdout 'LDP'
env GOARCH=

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/backendkinds

go 1.27

-- m/goonly/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

type pairLoad08 struct {
	A int64
	B int64
}

//go:noinline
func loadPair(p *pairLoad08) (int64, int64) {
	return p.A, p.B
}

func main() {
	p := &pairLoad08{A: 1, B: 2}
	a, b := loadPair(p)
	fmt.Println(a, b)
}

-- m/lgoonly/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

type pairLoad08 struct {
	A int64
	B int64
}

//go:noinline
func loadPair(p *pairLoad08) (int64, int64) {
	return p.A, p.B
}

func main() {
	p := &pairLoad08{A: 1, B: 2}
	a, b := loadPair(p)
	fmt.Println(a, b)
}
